memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text:
"On that same night I will pass through Egypt and strike down every firstborn of
both people and animals, and I will bring judgment on all the gods of Egypt. I
am the LORD. The blood will be a sign for you on the houses where you are; and
when I see the blood, I will pass over you. No destructive plague will touch you
when I strike Egypt." - Ex 12:12-13 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
Here is the heart of Passover, and one phrase deserves our full attention: "When
I see the blood, I will pass over you."

Not when I see your obedience. Not when I see how well you have kept the rules.
Not when I see a family worth saving. When I see the blood.

That night, inside those houses, there would have been every kind of person. Some
full of faith, some full of fear, some perhaps still doubting. Their feelings
did not determine their safety. The blood did.

Notice too that God says He will bring judgment "on all the gods of Egypt." This
was never merely a contest with Pharaoh. Egypt worshipped the Nile, the sun, the
frog, the cattle, the king himself. Each plague had exposed one of these as
powerless. The living God was showing that the idols people trust cannot save
them.

Both truths still stand. Our idols cannot protect us, and our performance cannot
save us. Only the blood.

If you are struggling today with whether God accepts you, look away from
yourself. God is not looking at your record. He is looking at His Son.

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
1. Are you resting in the blood or in your own spiritual performance?
2. What "gods" in your life have promised protection they cannot give?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text:
Father, thank You that my safety does not depend on my feelings or my record,
but on the blood of Jesus. When You look at me, see Him. Amen.
